title: sanity-report
description: What saga records for one source file, and the content of its .qa sidecar: every issue the instruments found, and every fault — an instrument that could not do its work on this file. A report with no issues and no faults says the file was fully examined and nothing was found. A report with a fault says part of the examination did not happen; its issues are then what the remaining instruments found.

relative_path.description: The path a report shows for the file.

content_hash.description: sha256 of the source as examined. Absent when the source could not be hashed; a fault then says why.

generated_at.description: Seconds since the Unix epoch, UTC.

code.description: The check or rule that fired.

message.description: What was found, at this line.

detail.description: A gleipnir check's detail, as gleipnir_messages.toml defines it.

faults.description: Every instrument that could not do its work on this file. Empty when all of them ran.

tool.description: The instrument that did not do its work.

mode.description: The failure mode, by its name in the error registry (failure_modes.toml).

class.description: The failure class of that mode.

message.description: The mode's standard message with its route.
